entry.title: RouteCraft: Stable Expert Routing for Large Mixture-of-Experts Models
entry.summary: We propose a new architecture for mixture of experts language models with stable expert routing. Extensive experiments on billion parameter models include strong baselines and ablation studies. We release our code.

entry.title: Seeing Longer: A Long-Context Vision-Language Model Architecture
entry.summary: We propose a novel method for a multimodal large language model with a new architecture and long context. Large-scale evaluation reports state-of-the-art results and detailed ablation experiments.

entry.title: ToolWeaver: Efficient Test-Time Planning for Language Agents
entry.summary: We propose a new framework for an LLM agent that improves tool use and reasoning with test-time compute. Extensive experiments compare against strong baselines, and code is available.

entry.title: Preference Optimization Without a Reference Model
entry.summary: We propose an algorithm for post-training large language models using preference optimization. A theoretical analysis and extensive experiments study the objective at scale.

entry.title: FastKV: Memory-Efficient Inference for Transformer Language Models
entry.summary: We propose a memory efficient KV cache algorithm for large language model inference. Experiments include an ablation and comparisons with strong baselines.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Coordination
entry.summary: We introduce a benchmark and evaluation protocol for multi-agent systems powered by language models. The dataset and leaderboard will be open source.

entry.title: Safer Language Models Through Adaptive Alignment
entry.summary: We study language model safety and jailbreak robustness. We propose a method and evaluate it on a public benchmark.

entry.title: Clinical Language Models for Hospital Discharge Notes
entry.summary: We evaluate a language model for medical patient records and clinical discharge summaries in healthcare.

entry.title: An Old Language Model Paper Outside the Lookback Window
entry.summary: We propose a large language model architecture.
